subpages.text: 01295 278356 sales@vcssmarthomes.com Home About Us Technology Showroom Services Smart Home Installation Home Automation Installation Home Cinema Smart Blinds Installation Smart Lighting Installation Heating Security Multiroom Audio Systems Networking and Wifi Distributed Video Systems Smart Home Maintenance Quotation and Planning Technology Arcam BakPak Blustream Control4 Crestron Dahua Door Entry Systems Draytek Epson Heatmiser Lutron Mirror Television Planet Qmotion Blinds Ruckus Sonance Sonos Sony Starscape Fibre Optics Triad Unifi Yamaha Wisdom Case Studies Cambridge Coach House Blog Contact What Level of CCTV Do Insurers Expect for Small Businesses? 15 April 2026 | By Gemma Lewis | Smart Security A practical guide to what insurers usually look for and where small firms go wrong There is no single universal “insurance level” of CCTV for every small business. What insurers usually want is a proportionate , reliable and well-maintained system that reduces risk, captures usable footage , and is operated lawfully. For most small firms, that means clear camera coverage of entrances , exits , tills , stock areas and vulnerable access points , along with proper signage , sensible retention settings , maintenance records and a documented reason for using CCTV. The important point is this: the right setup depends on your risk profile , not just how many cameras you install. Contents. What level of CCTV do insurers expect for small businesses?
